summary: Tested new Edit Profile (email/username) + Change Password feature. Backend: 17/18 pytest cases pass (1 skipped — Google-guard requires direct DB seeding). Frontend: After an Expo restart all testIDs render, ACCOUNT + CHANGE PASSWORD cards display correctly, validation toasts (mismatched confirm + short password) fire as designed, password change toast appears, and Profile save toast appears. Password change is confirmed persistent: after the UI flow finished, `POST /api/auth/login` with `newpass789` returns 200 and with `oldpass123` returns 401 — meaning the new password is live in MongoDB. Email save also returns 'Profile saved' toast. Deprecated packages detected: none new. SafeAreaView issues detected: none new. NOTE: Stale Metro bundle bug surfaced during testing — see context_for_next_testing_agent.

minor.issue: Username uniqueness check on PATCH is case-sensitive (normalises new value to lowercase then does literal Mongo lookup), while signup is case-insensitive (regex with $options=i). So if user A has username 'Foo' (case preserved at signup), user B can PATCH to 'foo' and won't see a collision. Not exploitable in practice today because signup also lower-cases for storage in most paths, but worth tightening to a case-insensitive check on PATCH for parity.

issues: ACCOUNT and CHANGE PASSWORD cards are positioned between the Basics card (Name/Suburb/Birthday) and the ABOUT ME card. Users have to scroll past the avatar picker (PHOTO + face picker + emoji picker + STYLE/SKIN/HAIR/GLASSES) and the Basics card before they see them. For a feature that's explicitly answering 'how do I update my email or password', consider hoisting the ACCOUNT card above PHOTO, or adding an anchor/link from the Profile screen straight to '#account' / '#password'.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Tighten the PATCH /profile username uniqueness lookup to be case-insensitive (regex with $options=i), matching the signup behaviour, so an edge-case mixed-case clash can't slip past.
(Optional / UX) Hoist the ACCOUNT card above the PHOTO card or add a deep link from the Profile screen so the new email/password controls are discoverable without scrolling past the avatar picker.

(No code fix needed) Note for next testing agent: edit-profile.tsx changes only render after `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` because the running Metro is in CI mode (reloads disabled). This was the cause of the first three failed UI runs and is not a code bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1837 — change_password depends on `current_user`. The 403 'You can only change your own password' check correctly compares user.id against the path user_id (allowing is_admin override). Looks good.
server.py L1850-1853 — Demo + Google-OAuth-only accounts are both rejected before the bcrypt verify call. Good defence-in-depth.
server.py L1796 — Google email guard only triggers if google_id is set AND the new email differs. A Google user PATCH-ing with the same email is a no-op, which is the right behaviour.
edit-profile.tsx L97 — Skips sending `email` if unchanged or empty. Good — avoids accidental 'already in use' errors when saving non-account fields.

edit-profile.tsx L122-148 — Client-side validation (length, mismatch, same-as-current) mirrors the backend rules so users get instant feedback before the network call. Toasts wired to the right backend error messages.
seed_data_creation: Created real user `pwtest_ui` via /api/auth/signup. Password is now `newpass789` (rotated during testing from initial `oldpass123`). Email: pwtest_ui_save<ts>@example.com (was pwtest_ui@example.com). Test classes also create TEST_prof_*, TEST_pw_* users that are not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Metro runs with CI=true (reloads disabled) so any change to /app/frontend/app/*.tsx requires `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` before the new bundle is served. Don't waste cycles debugging 'missing components' — restart first. 2) testID on React Native TextInput DOES render as data-testid on the underlying <input> in this app (web export confirmed working for profile-email, profile-username, profile-current-password, profile-new-password, profile-confirm-password). The login screen's PasswordField wrapper is the exception — use `input[placeholder="Your password"]` there. 3) Brute-force lockout is 5 fails / 15 min per account — if a UI login keeps returning 400, switch to a freshly signed-up user or wait 15 min. 4) For real-account testing, sign up a new user via /api/auth/signup; demo accounts (maggie, frankie, etc.) are blocked from /password and /username changes by design.
rca_of_issue: No production bug to RCA. The only investigation needed was the initial 'ACCOUNT and CHANGE PASSWORD cards missing from DOM' symptom — root cause was a stale Metro bundle (Metro in CI mode does not hot-reload). After `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` the new edit-profile.tsx code was bundled and every testID + section header rendered correctly. Backend behaviour confirmed via curl: login with `newpass789` returns 200, login with old `oldpass123` returns 401 — password rotation persisted to MongoDB as expected.
